personas.title: Community Health Worker
personas.description: A frontline member of the health workforce who delivers health interventions at the community level, acting as a link between communities and formal health facilities. Community health workers are a key sub-group of healthcare providers.

personas.title: Health Data Manager and Analyst
personas.description: A professional who manages, analyses, and disseminates health data to support evidence-based decision-making. This corresponds to the 'Data services' user group in CDISAH v2, providing crosscutting functionality across the health system.

personas.title: Health System Manager
personas.description: A professional involved in the administration and oversight of health systems.

personas.title: Healthcare Provider
personas.description: A member of the health workforce who delivers health interventions. This group has also been described as 'health workers' or 'healthcare workers'.

personas.title: Person (Health Service User)
personas.description: A member of the public who is a potential or current user of health services, including health prevention and wellness activities. Other terms used for this group include 'patient', 'client', 'individual', and 'health service user'. Caregivers of individuals receiving health services are also included.

personas.title: Client Registry / Master Patient Index
personas.description: A digital system that creates, maintains, and provides authoritative unique identifiers for individuals (persons) accessing health services, enabling cross-facility patient matching and de-duplication.

personas.title: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) System
personas.description: A secure, digital system that holds information about people's health and clinical care managed by healthcare providers. Also referred to as an Electronic Health Record (EHR).

personas.title: Health Management Information System (HMIS)
personas.description: A digital system used to collect, process, report, and use aggregate health data for programme planning, monitoring, and evaluation at district and national levels.

personas.title: Health Information Exchange / Interoperability Platform
personas.description: A middleware system or shared infrastructure that enables health data exchange between disparate health information systems using standard protocols and formats.

personas.title: Laboratory Information System (LIS)
personas.description: A digital system that manages the complete lifecycle of laboratory test orders, specimen tracking, result production, and result reporting to healthcare providers and persons.

personas.title: Logistics Management Information System (LMIS)
personas.description: A digital system that manages the health supply chain from quantification and forecasting through distribution, inventory management, and consumption tracking.

personas.title: Public Health and Disease Surveillance System
personas.description: A digital system for detecting, monitoring, investigating, and responding to disease outbreaks and public health threats.
